https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/live.text: Broadcasting an execution could cause post-traumatic stress disorder in the viewing public, mental health experts have said after Hegseth’s announcement that the firing squad execution of Nidal Hasan – the former US army psychiatrist who killed 13 people at Fort Hood – would be livestreamed.
